turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! Are you ready for Saturday? I've already bought snacks for the beach!

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi, Omar. Actually, I've just heard the weather forecast. It says there'll be strong wind and rain on Saturday.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh no, really? So the beach isn't a good idea.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, not on Saturday. Sunday will be sunny, but you work until three, don't you?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes. If we leave at three thirty, we'll get there at five. It gets dark at six.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's too short. What do you think about going next Saturday instead? The forecast says it'll be sunny.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good idea. But what do we do this Saturday? I don't want to stay at home all day.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How about the new science museum in the morning, and then lunch at the fish restaurant near the river? It's indoors, so the rain won't matter.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hmm, museums aren't really my thing. What about the cinema?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd prefer the museum. It has interactive rooms, so it isn't boring. But we could see a film in the evening too.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. So this Saturday, the museum at ten, then lunch, and a film in the evening. And the beach next Saturday.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Perfect. I'll keep the snacks for next week!
